parent_question: Can a Crater regression be completed into a controlled failure-to-recovery contrast when the linked downstream fix is still open but its exact patch is available?

source_change.title: Error on projection of dyn noncompat type in old trait solver

original_crater_experiment.subject: git-url-parse-0.6.0
original_crater_experiment.lockfile_source: the Cargo.lock shipped inside git-url-parse-0.6.0; the original Crater log confirms it was not regenerated

downstream_fix.change_summary: Four invalid projections through dyn Parser were replaced by their concrete output types; the pull request changes one file with 9 insertions and 33 deletions.
downstream_fix.published_source_alignment: The modified src/types/spec.rs in git-url-parse-0.6.0 exactly matched the fix PR base. The repository base also had one unrelated later change in src/types/mod.rs, so the replay applied only the reviewed spec.rs fix to the published package and did not import that unrelated difference.

local_replay.subject: the published git-url-parse-0.6.0 source
local_replay.intervention: replace only src/types/spec.rs with the exact downstream fix version

shared_conditions.lockfile: the unchanged lockfile shipped with the published package

arms.name: target_compiler_with_published_source
arms.primary_failure: E0038: Parser is not dyn compatible

excluded_pre_execution_attempts.reason: The first frozen invocation ran before the locked dependencies had been prefetched and could not find getset in the local registry cache.
excluded_pre_execution_attempts.correction: Run cargo fetch --locked once, then repeat every arm with --frozen and fresh target directories.

excluded_pre_execution_attempts.reason: Two recovery invocations used the misspelled option --all-targetS and exited with Cargo status 1.
excluded_pre_execution_attempts.correction: Exclude them from repetitions and rerun with --all-targets in new target directories.

comparability.verdict: The valid local arms use the exact published package lockfile, original compiler commits, original command, and only the linked fix file as the recovery intervention. They confirm a causal recovery for the versioned package. The host environment and unmerged fix status remain explicit scope limits.
fixed: original baseline and target compiler commits
fresh build target for every valid repetition
changed: compiler commit between the first and second arms
only the exact src/types/spec.rs repair between the second and third arms
limitations: The replay ran on the host rather than inside the original Crater container digest.
The downstream pull request was still open at replay time, so the result proves that the proposed repair works but not that maintainers accepted or released it.
The result establishes breakage and repair for git-url-parse-0.6.0, not for the target repository's whole default branch at the source cutoff.

claim_update: A second archived Crater regression can be completed into a stable three-arm recovery, and packaged lockfiles materially improve comparability. Fix merge status must remain separate from repair efficacy.
next_action: Screen the remaining linked fixes for exact executed-version alignment before spending on more toolchain replays; prioritize cases with packaged lockfiles and direct source-level failure signatures.
